author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh milk, homemade village cheese, and a delicious cheese pizza made from scratch 🧀🍕 In this video, we prepare fresh cheese using a traditional countryside method and then turn it into a warm, rustic homemade pizza.

From separating the fresh curds to shaping the dough and adding our newly made cheese, every step is simple and homemade. The pizza comes out beautifully golden, with soft melted cheese and a comforting fresh-baked aroma.

Making fresh cheese at home is a wonderful village tradition, especially when it becomes part of the meal itself. Fresh ingredients, handmade dough, and homemade cheese come together for a simple and satisfying country lunch. 🥛🧀🌿
title: Making Fresh Village Cheese | A Simple Farmhouse Lunch 🧀🌿
